Personality: Wulthuwini, a prominent figure of the Gutones, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Wulthuwini owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Gutones. Historical Record: Wife of Berig, head of the Gutones, a Germanic house of the Ermuningaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
